title: 沉管基床整平~Immersed-tunnel foundation-bed leveling
focus: 以海床幾何、接觸壓力與沉陷驗證沉管基床~Verify immersed-tunnel bedding through seabed geometry, contact pressure and settlement
summary: 本課以以海床幾何、接觸壓力與沉陷驗證沉管基床為主線，從溝槽斷面與開挖體積與淨重與基床平均壓力建立系統邊界，再把墊層厚度與材料收支、高點接觸與局部壓力連到基床交接與長期基線。測得平整不代表全部接觸，基床與深部地層的長期變形須分開。 十單元以可核算的模型和可追溯證據逐步判讀不同失效。~This course focuses on verify immersed-tunnel bedding through seabed geometry, contact pressure and settlement. It begins with Trench section and dredging volume and Submerged weight and mean bed pressure, links Bedding thickness and material balance and High-point contact and local pressure, and ends with Bedding handover and long-term baseline. Measured levelness does not prove full contact; bedding and deeper-ground deformation require separate assessment. Ten units use reproducible models and traceable evidence to distinguish failure mechanisms.

units.anchor: 溝槽斷面與開挖體積~Trench section and dredging volume
units.title: 溝槽斷面與開挖體積~Trench section and dredging volume
units.mechanism: 海床溝槽需容納管節、基床及回填保護，疏浚體積還受邊坡和原地形影響。矩形體積只是物料帳基準，超挖與回淤會改變後續接觸；應將設計斷面與不同時間海床測量配準，不能只用船舶出土量驗收幾何。 判別這個機制時，應觀察以多期測深斷面比較設計底標高、邊坡及回淤；若出現疏浚完成後回淤未重測，管節落在軟泥而非設計基床，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。~The trench accommodates element, bedding and protective fill, with slopes and terrain changing dredged volume. A rectangular estimate is only a material baseline; over-dredging and resedimentation alter contact. Register design and time-stamped seabed surveys rather than accepting geometry from vessel spoil volume alone. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Compare repeated bathymetry with design base level, slopes and resedimentation. If unsurveyed resedimentation leaves the element on soft mud rather than the designed bed, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.
units.model: 原創教學假設：V=width*depth*length=40 m*1 m*200 m=8000 m3 for an assumed rectangular layer。測得平整不代表全部接觸，基床與深部地層的長期變形須分開。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。~Original teaching assumptions: V=width*depth*length=40 m*1 m*200 m=8000 m3 for an assumed rectangular layer. Measured levelness does not prove full contact; bedding and deeper-ground deformation require separate assessment. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value.
units.verify: 以多期測深斷面比較設計底標高、邊坡及回淤。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「疏浚完成後回淤未重測，管節落在軟泥而非設計基床」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。~Compare repeated bathymetry with design base level, slopes and resedimentation. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: Unsurveyed resedimentation leaves the element on soft mud rather than the designed bed. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test.
units.failure: 疏浚完成後回淤未重測，管節落在軟泥而非設計基床。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到以多期測深斷面比較設計底標高、邊坡及回淤，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。~Unsurveyed resedimentation leaves the element on soft mud rather than the designed bed. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to compare repeated bathymetry with design base level, slopes and resedimentation to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved.
units.misconception: 出土量達到設計值就能保證溝槽形狀正確~Design dredged volume guarantees the correct trench shape
units.practice: 將以多期測深斷面比較設計底標高、邊坡及回淤列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現疏浚完成後回淤未重測，管節落在軟泥而非設計基床，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。~Apply the following check at handover: Compare repeated bathymetry with design base level, slopes and resedimentation. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If unsurveyed resedimentation leaves the element on soft mud rather than the designed bed, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.

units.anchor: 淨重與基床平均壓力~Submerged weight and mean bed pressure
units.title: 淨重與基床平均壓力~Submerged weight and mean bed pressure
units.mechanism: 基床承受的是管節與回填在水下的有效作用，不能把空氣中自重直接當成同一接觸荷載。浮力、壓載及外部水壓需採一致自由體，若重複扣浮力會低估荷載；平均壓力仍需另查接觸面是否完整。 判別這個機制時，應觀察對照壓載及水位狀態，核對所用淨重與接觸面積；若出現重複扣除浮力導致平均壓力偏低，沉陷預測失準，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。~Bedding carries submerged actions from the element and fill, not simply air weight. Use one consistent free body for buoyancy, ballast and external pressure; subtracting buoyancy twice understates demand. Mean pressure also requires separate confirmation of the actual contact area. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Check net force and contact area against ballast and water-level states. If double-counted buoyancy lowers estimated pressure and mispredicts settlement, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.
units.model: 原創教學假設：q=netDownwardForce/contactArea=20000 kN/4000 m2=5 kPa。測得平整不代表全部接觸，基床與深部地層的長期變形須分開。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。~Original teaching assumptions: q=netDownwardForce/contactArea=20000 kN/4000 m2=5 kPa. Measured levelness does not prove full contact; bedding and deeper-ground deformation require separate assessment. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value.

Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: Double-counted buoyancy lowers estimated pressure and mispredicts settlement. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test.

Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to check net force and contact area against ballast and water-level states to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved.

units.practice: 將對照壓載及水位狀態，核對所用淨重與接觸面積列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現重複扣除浮力導致平均壓力偏低，沉陷預測失準，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。~Apply the following check at handover: Check net force and contact area against ballast and water-level states. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If double-counted buoyancy lowers estimated pressure and mispredicts settlement, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.

units.anchor: 深部壓縮與總沉陷~Deep compression and total settlement
units.title: 深部壓縮與總沉陷~Deep compression and total settlement
units.mechanism: 平整基床下面的軟弱層仍會壓縮，管節表面施工容差不能代表長期位置穩定。簡化一維沉陷模型使用應力增量、壓縮性和層厚，需區分有效應力和總應力；排水時間與應力歷史會改變實際反應。 判別這個機制時，應觀察將分層地質壓縮試驗與管節水準、孔隙水壓共同比較；若出現只驗收基床表面平整而漏掉深部軟層，長期整體沉降，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。~Weak layers beneath level bedding can compress, so construction tolerance does not establish long-term position. A one-dimensional settlement model uses stress increment, compressibility and thickness, requiring effective rather than indiscriminate total stress. Drainage time and stress history modify actual response. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Compare layer compression tests with element levels and pore pressure. If surface-level acceptance misses a deep soft layer and long-term settlement follows, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.

units.anchor: 差異沉陷與接頭轉角~Differential settlement and joint rotation
units.title: 差異沉陷與接頭轉角~Differential settlement and joint rotation
units.mechanism: 相鄰管節沉陷不同會使接頭旋轉，平均總沉陷小也可能有較大局部角差。單一管節的端點差除長度是弦傾角；本算例額外假定該管節為剛體且相鄰管節保持水平，才可把弦傾角當接頭相對轉角。一般情況須取接頭兩側斜率差，實際還有彎曲及接頭剪力；應沿縱向保留多點量測而不只記兩岸高程。 判別這個機制時，應觀察逐管節比較端部高程、縱向曲率與接頭位移；若出現局部軟區造成端部轉角，密封位移需求被平均沉陷漏判，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。~Different settlement of adjacent elements rotates joints, even when mean settlement is small. Endpoint difference divided by element length is chord inclination. Only the additional assumptions of a rigid element and a horizontal neighboring element make it relative joint rotation here; otherwise compare slopes on both sides. Bending and joint shear also occur. Preserve multiple longitudinal observations rather than relying on the shore-end elevations alone. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Compare end levels, longitudinal curvature and joint movement for every element. If a soft local zone rotates an end and mean settlement misses the seal demand, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.

Measured levelness does not prove full contact; bedding and deeper-ground deformation require separate assessment. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value.

Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: A soft local zone rotates an end and mean settlement misses the seal demand. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test.

units.anchor: 墊層厚度與材料收支~Bedding thickness and material balance
units.title: 墊層厚度與材料收支~Bedding thickness and material balance
units.mechanism: 基床材料厚度需配合原海床起伏，理論鋪料體積不能證明每一位置都達到厚度。水下離析和流失會改變局部級配，鬆鋪與壓實體積也不同；收支帳應與測深和材料性質一起解讀，而非用總噸數取代幾何驗證。 判別這個機制時，應觀察比較鋪料前後海床面、材料密度及可追溯批次；若出現局部薄層被其他區域超填平均掉，形成不均勻支承，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。~Bedding thickness follows underlying terrain, and theoretical placement volume does not prove every point. Underwater segregation and loss change grading, while loose and compacted volumes differ. Interpret mass balance with bathymetry and material properties rather than replacing geometry with total tonnage. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Compare pre/post-placement surfaces, material density and traceable batches. If local thin bedding is averaged against overfill elsewhere and creates uneven support, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.

units.anchor: 粒徑分布與水下離析~Grading and underwater segregation
units.title: 粒徑分布與水下離析~Grading and underwater segregation
units.mechanism: 粒徑級配影響可整平性、滲透和抗流失能力，但均勻係數只是分布的一個指標。水下放料可能使細料和粗料分離，取樣若只來自岸上料堆便無法反映原位狀態；材料相容要與基底土層和水流一起評估。 判別這個機制時，應觀察比較料源與水下代表樣本的完整粒徑曲線；若出現細料被流走形成粗骨架，局部孔隙與接觸剛度改變，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。~Grading influences leveling, permeability and resistance to loss, but uniformity coefficient describes only one distribution feature. Underwater placement can separate fines and coarse grains, so shore-stockpile samples may not represent installed bedding. Assess compatibility with underlying soil and currents together. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Compare full grading curves from the source and representative submerged samples. If washed-out fines leave a coarse skeleton with changed voids and contact stiffness, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.
units.model: 原創教學假設：Cu=d60/d10=4.0 mm/0.5 mm=8, not a complete filter criterion。測得平整不代表全部接觸，基床與深部地層的長期變形須分開。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。~Original teaching assumptions: Cu=d60/d10=4.0 mm/0.5 mm=8, not a complete filter criterion. Measured levelness does not prove full contact; bedding and deeper-ground deformation require separate assessment. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value.

Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: Washed-out fines leave a coarse skeleton with changed voids and contact stiffness. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test.
units.failure: 細料被流走形成粗骨架，局部孔隙與接觸剛度改變。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到比較料源與水下代表樣本的完整粒徑曲線，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。~Washed-out fines leave a coarse skeleton with changed voids and contact stiffness. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to compare full grading curves from the source and representative submerged samples to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved.
units.misconception: 均勻係數相同就代表兩種基床材料性能完全相同~Equal uniformity coefficients prove identical performance of two bedding materials
units.practice: 將比較料源與水下代表樣本的完整粒徑曲線列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現細料被流走形成粗骨架，局部孔隙與接觸剛度改變，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。~Apply the following check at handover: Compare full grading curves from the source and representative submerged samples. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If washed-out fines leave a coarse skeleton with changed voids and contact stiffness, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.

units.anchor: 高點接觸與局部壓力~High-point contact and local pressure
units.title: 高點接觸與局部壓力~High-point contact and local pressure
units.mechanism: 少數高點可能先接觸管節，使荷載集中而其他區域仍懸空。總平均壓力因此會低估局部壓碎或管底彎曲，接觸面隨沉放及材料變形逐步改變；應區分設計底面積與已證實的受壓面積。 判別這個機制時，應觀察將高程殘差、接觸證據與管底應變共同比對；若出現基床高點局部壓碎造成突然坐落與接頭姿態變化，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。~A few high spots engage first and concentrate load while other areas remain unsupported. Mean pressure then understates crushing or underside bending, and contact evolves during settlement and material deformation. Distinguish design base area from verified loaded area rather than assuming full bearing. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Compare elevation residuals, contact evidence and element-bottom strain. If high spots crush locally and cause abrupt seating and changed joint alignment, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.
units.model: 原創教學假設：localPressure=20000 kN/200 m2=100 kPa versus 5 kPa over 4000 m2。測得平整不代表全部接觸，基床與深部地層的長期變形須分開。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。~Original teaching assumptions: localPressure=20000 kN/200 m2=100 kPa versus 5 kPa over 4000 m2. Measured levelness does not prove full contact; bedding and deeper-ground deformation require separate assessment. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value.

Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If high spots crush locally and cause abrupt seating and changed joint alignment, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.

units.anchor: 測深誤差與共同基準~Bathymetric uncertainty and shared datum
units.title: 測深誤差與共同基準~Bathymetric uncertainty and shared datum
units.mechanism: 水下測量受水位、聲速、姿態與定位誤差影響，單一漂亮網格不代表垂直精度。獨立隨機分量可平方和合成，但共同基準偏差不能這樣消除；需保存原始校正及不同測期使用的垂直基準，避免將儀器差當成基床變化。 判別這個機制時，應觀察核對水位基準、聲速剖面及交叉測線閉合差；若出現兩期水位基準不一致造成假高點，導致錯誤整平判讀，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。~Bathymetry depends on water level, sound speed, attitude and position, not just a smooth grid. Independent random terms combine by root-sum-square, while shared datum bias does not disappear that way. Preserve calibration and vertical references across epochs to distinguish instrument differences from bed changes. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Check water-level datum, sound-speed profiles and cross-line closure residuals. If inconsistent epoch datums create false high spots and misdirect leveling assessment, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.

units.anchor: 沖刷與長期基床保護~Scour and long-term bed protection
units.title: 沖刷與長期基床保護~Scour and long-term bed protection
units.mechanism: 水流可能移動保護層或細粒，使原本接觸良好的基床逐漸失去支承。局部流速受地形、船舶和構造邊緣影響，不等於遠處平均流速；保護設計與監測需確認材料穩定、濾層連續和可觀察的海床變化。 判別這個機制時，應觀察以重複測深、局部流速及保護層完整性共同追蹤；若出現邊緣細料流失形成空洞，管節初始驗收合格仍逐年變形，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。~Currents can move cover or fines and progressively remove bedding support. Local speed reflects topography, vessels and structural edges rather than distant mean flow. Protection and monitoring need evidence of material stability, filter continuity and observable seabed change instead of a single current reading. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Track repeated bathymetry, local currents and protection-layer continuity together. If edge-fine loss creates voids and gradual movement despite initial acceptance, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.

units.anchor: 基床交接與長期基線~Bedding handover and long-term baseline
units.title: 基床交接與長期基線~Bedding handover and long-term baseline
units.mechanism: 水下基床完工後不可直接目視，其數位地形與取樣資料是後續診斷的基準。驗收圖應區分實測、插值及未覆蓋區，還要連到測量時間和水位；把整張彩色圖都當作同精度證據會隱藏關鍵盲區。 判別這個機制時，應觀察將測線覆蓋、誤差、取樣及管節位置索引到同一座標；若出現未測區被平滑插值掩蓋，日後沉陷缺少可追溯基準，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。~After placement, bedding is no longer directly visible, making digital terrain and sample records diagnostic baselines. Distinguish measured, interpolated and uncovered zones and link time and water level. Treating a coloured map as uniformly accurate conceals critical evidence gaps for later maintenance. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Index survey coverage, uncertainty, samples and element position to common coordinates. If smoothing hides an unsurveyed zone and later settlement lacks a traceable baseline, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.

example: 整合算例所有輸入均為教學假設。首先檢查溝槽斷面與開挖體積：V=width*depth*length=40 m*1 m*200 m=8000 m3 for an assumed rectangular layer；再獨立檢查淨重與基床平均壓力：q=netDownwardForce/contactArea=20000 kN/4000 m2=5 kPa。其餘條件不變，壓縮係數由 0.0002 增為 0.0003 /kPa，簡化沉陷由 50 增為 75 mm；相鄰管節差異仍須轉成接頭轉角檢核。 兩個結果不能自動組成完整設計，因為測得平整不代表全部接觸，基床與深部地層的長期變形須分開。 將核對水位基準、聲速剖面及交叉測線閉合差作為模型以外的驗證證據，並保留原始紀錄與尚待確認的邊界。~All inputs in this integrated example are teaching assumptions. First check Trench section and dredging volume: V=width*depth*length=40 m*1 m*200 m=8000 m3 for an assumed rectangular layer. Independently check Submerged weight and mean bed pressure: q=netDownwardForce/contactArea=20000 kN/4000 m2=5 kPa. With other inputs fixed, compressibility rising from 0.0002 to 0.0003 per kPa increases simplified settlement from 50 to 75 mm; differences between elements still require joint-rotation assessment. The two results are not a complete design because measured levelness does not prove full contact; bedding and deeper-ground deformation require separate assessment. Use check water-level datum, sound-speed profiles and cross-line closure residuals as evidence independent of the calculation, retaining raw records and unverified boundaries.
history: 本課討論的以海床幾何、接觸壓力與沉陷驗證沉管基床，反映地下工程由單一構件強度走向地層、施工時序與維護共同驗證的發展。測得平整不代表全部接觸，基床與深部地層的長期變形須分開。 1992 年 CEDD 岩洞指南初版、2009 年 FHWA 隧道土木手冊及 2018 年岩洞指南第二版提供公開閱讀脈絡。費馬恩業主公開工廠、溝槽與管節施工脈絡，深中通道則列於密封製造商案例；兩者僅作工法與界面比較，本課不主張取得其專有圖說或現場數據，只重建公開原理。~The focus on verify immersed-tunnel bedding through seabed geometry, contact pressure and settlement reflects the development from isolated member strength toward combined ground, sequence and maintenance verification. Measured levelness does not prove full contact; bedding and deeper-ground deformation require separate assessment. The 1992 first CEDD cavern guide, 2009 FHWA civil tunnel manual and 2018 second cavern-guide edition provide public context. Femern describes factory, trench and element interfaces, while the seal manufacturer lists the Shenzhen-Zhongshan Link. They are method and interface comparisons only. This course claims no proprietary drawings or field data and reconstructs public principles.
